scoreReasons: Nothing on a public ledger for card-rail Agent Pay: tokens, authorizations and agent information stay inside card network and issuer systems. AP4M pilots settle on Base through Coinbase Developer Platform wallets (Mastercard, 2026-10-20).
No public Agent Pay event names or endpoints, apart from the MVCT token notifications used for guest checkout; AP4M APIs are in Early Access (2026-10-20) and their documentation is not public.
Mastercard publishes partner names and milestones but no transaction counts or values; the 2026-10-20 AP4M brief counts only the payments in its demo.
The only public, inspectable artifact is the Verifiable Intent repository, which earns the single point. The score may change if AP4M Early Access documentation becomes public.

public.where: Mastercard newsroom and Investor Relations PDFs
public.how: Read releases; they name banks and partners, never volumes.
Stars, forks, issues and commits; 101 stars and no commits since 2026-04-20 as of 2026-10-21.

public.how: Check for new Agent Pay services and documentation releases.

The Web Bot Auth drafts define /.well-known/http-message-signatures-directory; Mastercard's guide shows that path only in a ChatGPT example and gives no Agent Pay path. The only Mastercard host in the docs, agentpay-key-directory.mastercard.com, did not resolve on 2026-10-21, so the live location is unknown.
Download counts show interest in the documentation tools only, not in payments.
